about: Package tasks that fail today and that ci.yml skips until they are fixed. scripts/ci-quarantine.mjs turns this list into turbo --filter=!<package> arguments, validates it, and re-measures it: a report on main and a ratchet on pull requests.

The list may only shrink. Remove an entry when its task passes, and lower errors when the count falls. A build or typecheck entry is refused for a package that another package depends on, because turbo would run that task anyway.

errors counts TypeScript diagnostics (build, typecheck), ESLint errors (lint) or failing test files (test, where 0 means there are no test files). Counts come from pnpm --filter <package> run <task> after the install and build that the quarantine jobs in ci.yml run (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --config.side-effects-cache=false, then the non-quarantined build); first_error paths are relative to the package. measured_at is the commit whose package sources were measured.
Follow-up ids (F2-F9, O1) refer to the step-0 plan in the pull request that added this file.

measured_with.platform: darwin-arm64; the ubuntu ratchet run on the pull request that added this file measured the same 48 counts

status_drift.about: STATUS.md claims that these measurements contradict. They are recorded here rather than edited: a push to main that touches a STATUS.md starts Progress Sync, which configures AWS credentials, and owner decision D6 (dec-2026-10-17-7) rules out AWS action.
